provenance.encodes: The Indigo Book, T2 Department of Commerce, NOAA (Coastal Zone Management Act consistency appeals)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Indigo Book (https://law.resource.org/pub/us/code/blue/IndigoBook.html, CC0), T2 Department of Commerce, NOAA (Coastal Zone Management Act consistency appeals), and compare the form and examples with this pattern.

positive.text: Decision and Findings in the Consistency Appeal of Mobil Oil Exploration & Producing Southeast, Inc., from an objection by the State of Florida (Sec’y of Commerce Jan. 7, 1993).
See Decision and Findings in the Consistency Appeal of Millennium Pipeline Co., from an objection by the New York Department of State (Sec’y of Commerce Dec. 12, 2003).
Compare Decision and Findings in the Consistency Appeal of Foo Co., from an objection by the State of Maine (Sec'y of Commerce May 5, 2001).

negative: The Decision and Findings in the Consistency Appeal were long.
A consistency appeal from an objection by Florida took 3 years.
Decision and Findings (Sec’y of Commerce) are unpublished.
